text.content:
Small, neutral, and selling to everyone.

Industry: Computer hardware, avionics and AVs, drones and robotics
Known for: Strict neutrality: its drones fight on both sides of a war

Zetatech began as the smallest of the megacorps, designing computer hardware. Its size kept it out of the worst of the 4th Corporate War, and it used that head start to move into avionics, AVs, drones and robotics.

It sells to anyone, so it isn't unusual to find Zetatech drones on both sides of the same battle.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.24
